ground_truth.node_text: Start

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Please complete the following checks: First, inspect the drive amplifier heatsink fins for dust or blocked ventilation slots. Second, check the motor body for abnormal surface temperature with a contact thermometer. Third, inspect the drive amplifier display for thermal warning or fault codes.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect the drive amplifier heatsink fins for dust or blocked ventilation slots. 2. Check the motor body for abnormal surface temperature with a contact thermometer. 3. Inspect the drive amplifier display for thermal warning or fault codes.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Checks complete. Heatsink fins are clear, motor temperature is normal, and no thermal warnings are showing on the display.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect the drive amplifier heatsink fins for dust or blocked ventilation slots. 2. Check the motor body for abnormal surface temperature with a contact thermometer. 3. Inspect the drive amplifier display for thermal warning or fault codes.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Hold a calibrated infrared thermometer or contact thermocouple probe against the drive amplifier heatsink surface after the axis has been running under normal load for twenty minutes. Record the heatsink temperature and compare it against the maximum permitted temperature stated in the drive amplifier datasheet.

ground_truth.node_text: Hold a calibrated infrared thermometer or a contact thermocouple probe against the drive amplifier heatsink surface after the axis has been running under normal load for 20 minutes. Record the heatsink temperature and compare against the maximum permitted heatsink temperature stated in the drive amplifier datasheet. An overtemperature condition with normal ambient temperature indicates a failed cooling fan or blocked heatsink fins.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Temperature measurement complete. Heatsink is reading sixty-two degrees Celsius, which is below the maximum rated limit.

ground_truth.node_text: Hold a calibrated infrared thermometer or a contact thermocouple probe against the drive amplifier heatsink surface after the axis has been running under normal load for 20 minutes. Record the heatsink temperature and compare against the maximum permitted heatsink temperature stated in the drive amplifier datasheet. An overtemperature condition with normal ambient temperature indicates a failed cooling fan or blocked heatsink fins.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the drive heatsink temperature within the rated continuous limit?

ground_truth.node_text: Drive heatsink temperature within rated continuous limit?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the heatsink temperature is well within the rated continuous limit.

ground_truth.node_text: Drive heatsink temperature within rated continuous limit?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the winding resistance balanced within two percent across all phases?

ground_truth.node_text: Winding resistance balanced within 2% across all phases?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, I'm seeing an imbalance. Phase B is reading about three percent higher than phases A and C.

ground_truth.node_text: Winding resistance balanced within 2% across all phases?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Inspect the motor terminal block, tighten all connections, and check the insulation.

ground_truth.node_text: Inspect motor terminal block, tighten connections, check insulation

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Terminal block inspection complete. I've tightened the connections and verified the insulation is intact.

ground_truth.node_text: Inspect motor terminal block, tighten connections, check insulation

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Inspect the encoder read head status indicator light on the motor body or drive amplifier. Check the encoder cable continuity at both the motor connector and the drive connector using a continuity tester on each signal wire. Also inspect the cable route for crush damage, sharp bends, or contact with hot or moving surfaces.

ground_truth.node_text: Inspect the encoder read head status indicator light on the motor body or drive amplifier; green indicates a valid signal and red or flashing indicates a fault. Check the encoder cable continuity at both the motor connector and the drive connector using a continuity tester on each signal wire. Inspect the cable route for crush damage, sharp bends, or contact with hot or moving surfaces.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Encoder inspection complete. Status light is showing green, all signal wires have good continuity, and the cable routing looks good with no visible damage.

ground_truth.node_text: Inspect the encoder read head status indicator light on the motor body or drive amplifier; green indicates a valid signal and red or flashing indicates a fault. Check the encoder cable continuity at both the motor connector and the drive connector using a continuity tester on each signal wire. Inspect the cable route for crush damage, sharp bends, or contact with hot or moving surfaces.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the encoder hardware status normal with no fault flags in the drive?

ground_truth.node_text: Encoder hardware status normal, no fault flags in drive?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, encoder hardware is showing normal status and there are no fault flags present in the drive.

ground_truth.node_text: Encoder hardware status normal, no fault flags in drive?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the following error within the specified limit at all three speeds?

ground_truth.node_text: Following error within specified limit at all three speeds?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the following error is exceeding the limit, particularly at the higher test speeds.

ground_truth.node_text: Following error within specified limit at all three speeds?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Adjust the servo gain parameters Kp and Ki within the drive tuning limits.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust servo gain parameters, Kp, Ki within drive tuning limits

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Gain parameters adjusted. I've increased both Kp and Ki within the acceptable tuning range.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust servo gain parameters, Kp, Ki within drive tuning limits

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Please reverify the following error after the gain adjustment.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify following error after gain adjustment

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The following error is still exceeding the limit at the ninety percent speed test point.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify following error after gain adjustment

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Access the drive parameter menu and increase the proportional velocity gain by ten percent of its current value. Command a positioning move and read the following error value at the same three test speeds. If the error increases at any speed, restore the original gain value.

ground_truth.node_text: Secondary servo tuning attempt: access the drive parameter menu and increase the proportional velocity gain by 10% of its current value. Command a positioning move and read the following error value at the same three test speeds. If the error increases at any speed, restore the original gain value and note that mechanical resonance may be contributing, requiring a drive frequency spectrum analysis before returning to the following error measurement step.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Secondary tuning attempt complete. I've increased the velocity gain by ten percent and retested at all three speeds.

ground_truth.node_text: Secondary servo tuning attempt: access the drive parameter menu and increase the proportional velocity gain by 10% of its current value. turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Please reverify the following error after the gain adjustment.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify following error after gain adjustment

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Following error is now within limits at all three test speeds.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify following error after gain adjustment

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the position accuracy within plus or minus zero point zero zero five millimeters at all reference positions?

ground_truth.node_text: Position accuracy within ±0.005 mm at all reference positions?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, I'm seeing position errors exceeding the tolerance at several reference positions, with the maximum error at about zero point zero zero eight millimeters.

ground_truth.node_text: Position accuracy within ±0.005 mm at all reference positions?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Access the encoder calibration menu via the service laptop, select the encoder calibration routine, and follow the on-screen procedure. Record the calibration result and confirm the residual error is within tolerance.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following steps: 1. Access the encoder calibration menu via the service laptop. 2. Select the encoder calibration routine and follow the on-screen procedure. 3. Record the calibration result and confirm the residual error is within tolerance.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The calibration routine keeps timing out before it completes, and I'm getting a communication error between the encoder and the drive controller that's not clearing even after a reboot.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Encoder calibration routine complete. The calibration has finished but the residual error is still showing elevated values.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following steps: 1. Access the encoder calibration menu via the service laptop. 2. Select the encoder calibration routine and follow the on-screen procedure. 3. Record the calibration result and confirm the residual error is within tolerance.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Please reverify the position accuracy after encoder recalibration.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify position accuracy after encoder recalibration

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Position accuracy is still out of tolerance. The maximum error remains at about zero point zero zero seven millimeters.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify position accuracy after encoder recalibration

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Position accuracy is unrecoverable through encoder calibration. Escalate this issue for geometric check of the mechanical axis components. The axis should be placed on production hold pending further investigation.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Escalate: position accuracy unrecoverable, geometric check required

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Understood, I'll escalate for geometric inspection and mark the axis for production hold.
